categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in four primary business segments: (1) Ultra-high-definition smart display chips for set-top boxes, TVs, and commercial displays; (2) Smart vision chips for video surveillance and security applications; (3) Solid-state storage controller chips for SSDs and storage devices; and (4) Internet of Things chips including satellite navigation/positioning and wireless connectivity solutions. The company also provides integrated circuit research, design, and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a Fabless business model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized partners. Core proprietary technologies include: large-scale SoC chip design, video encoding/decoding (H.264/H.265, AVS2/AVS3), image signal processing (ISP), NPU (neural processing units), picture quality enhancement (PQ), advanced encryption, low-power design, multi-wafer packaging, and embedded software development. The company has accumulated significant intellectual property including patents, circuit layouts, and software copyrights.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include set-top box manufacturers, TV and commercial display makers, security/surveillance equipment manufacturers, SSD and storage device producers, and IoT device manufacturers. End markets served include cable television operators, IPTV/OTT service providers, direct broadcast satellite operators, smart city surveillance systems, data centers, and consumer electronics. The company serves both domestic Chinese operators and international customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Changsha, Hunan Province. It maintains subsidiary operations in multiple Chinese cities including Changzhou (Jiangsu), Chengdu (Sichuan), Jinan (Shandong), Shanghai, Beijing, and Hangzhou (Zhejiang). The company also has limited international presence with overseas subsidiaries and serves customers globally, with 2023 international revenue representing 6.92% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream design segment of the integrated circuit supply chain. As a Fabless designer, it focuses exclusively on chip design and development while outsourcing manufacturing (wafer fabrication), packaging, and testing to specialized service providers. The company sells its chips to downstream manufacturers and system integrators who incorporate them into end-user products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing ultra-high-definition video processing for 4K/8K applications and emerging platforms like HarmonyOS; (2) developing AI-enabled smart vision chips with advanced ISP and NPU capabilities; (3) expanding into automotive electronics with AEC-Q100 certified chips; (4) deepening national technology standards adoption (AVS, SVAC, HDR VIVID); (5) developing multi-source fusion positioning and low-power IoT solutions; (6) expanding wireless connectivity (Wi-Fi 4/6) product lines; and (7) pursuing edge AI and cloud-edge collaborative computing architectures.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of integrated circuit chips to equipment manufacturers and system integrators. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered to customers and control transfers. The company also provides engineering services and technical support. Sales occur through both direct sales channels (85.25% of 2023 revenue) and indirect distribution channels (14.75% of 2023 revenue). The company operates on a Fabless model with no manufacturing facilities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In ultra-high-definition display chips, competitors include Amlogic, MTK, Rockchip, and Allwinner. In smart vision chips, competitors include Fullhan Microelectronics, Beijing Zhoujin, Techwell, and Realtek. In storage controllers, the company competes with established international players. In navigation/positioning, competitors include other domestic GNSS chip designers. The company positions itself as a leading domestic IC design company with particular strength in video processing and emerging leadership in AI-enabled vision and automotive applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company generated RMB 4.23 billion in annual revenue (17.38% growth year-over-year), with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 96.07 million. Total assets reached RMB 7.34 billion. The company has demonstrated strong revenue growth trajectory, though profitability declined in 2023 due to high R&D investments (RMB 612.49 million, 14.48% of revenue) and competitive pricing pressures. The company maintains substantial cash reserves and positive operating cash flow (RMB 889.71 million in 2023).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive product portfolios covering complete application scenarios in target markets; (2) advanced proprietary technologies in video encoding/decoding, AI processing, and low-power design; (3) strong support for Chinese national standards (AVS, SVAC, HDR VIVID, TVOS); (4) proven reliability and quality in mission-critical applications; (5) integrated solutions combining hardware and software; and (6) rapid innovation cycles delivering next-generation capabilities. The company emphasizes being a trusted domestic alternative to foreign suppliers while maintaining world-class technical capabilities.
